name: Neris Coale
aliases: the only frame on the roster

identity.realm: Sixth gate of the Body ladder, opened in a frame belonging to somebody else, and the wall at the far end of it is the colony's routing rather than the host's

appearance.presentation: The tendril layer of a paired body, read from the outside: a sternum root cluster that shifts under the skin, darker tracery running the length of both forearms and across the collarbone, and a quiet swelling at the base of the throat. She is not a shape a person can step back from, and everything said to her is said to the body she is inside.
appearance.age: Twelve seasons developed, into a host who was thirty-one. The colony has run on the host's clock since implantation and has run slower than a calendar on purpose.
appearance.build: Not her own, and she says so. The host is long through the shoulder and thick through the back, guild-shaped and heavier on one side, and she describes it in the guild's own measure because that is the only vocabulary she has ever been taught for a body.
appearance.complexion: The host's, warm and work-worn, going grey at the temples some years ahead of the guild's expectation for the trade.
appearance.hair: The host's, cropped short at the back and left long enough to be pinned out of the way, on the guild's rule that anything that might be in a fire gets cut.
appearance.eyes: The host's, pale and quick, and trained to stop on whatever hand is nearest. What runs behind them belongs to neither half and neither half can close it.
appearance.palette: Soot, undyed wool and wet slate, with iron at the buckles and a jade undertone in the tracery at the forearms and throat. There is no green anywhere else on the body and never has been.
appearance.attire: The guild's cold cut: layered, heavy, fastenings permanently undone, designed to come off in a second because immersion waits for nobody. Worn as issued by the host, who has never owned a garment the colony could be said to have chosen.
appearance.marks: A knot of tissue at the sternum root, tracery from fingertips to elbow on both arms and over the collarbone, and a throat node the host touches without being told to and without noticing that she touches it.
appearance.bearing: Entirely still above the collar and never once still below it. At a distance this reads as a builder at rest. It is in fact two systems continuously negotiating the use of one pair of hands.

canon.role_in_story: The guild-house that rents capacity keeps a roster of names whose labour is worth more than any individual contract, and it is correct about this one: a signed pair carries two bodies of work under a single standing order, and neither half can be priced apart, because parting them is the one outcome neither half survives. She is the only trainer on that roster. Every gate she has opened, she opened in a frame she did not build, cannot own and did not choose, and a Body gate is closed by holding a charge in something that will not move — so the plains give her standing flood water, which moves. The certification office has no budget, no seat and no practitioners and exists precisely because the tier licenses no humanoid, so its word is the only reading this ground can issue and it issues it from outside. It cannot read a paired body. What it can read is a frame. The frame admits one body here, and the pair is the reason nobody will book them for the second gate, which is the cheapest to enter and the most expensive to be wrong at.
canon.first_appearance: First seen waist-deep at the lip of a flood line with the host's palm flat on the water and both of them explaining to a figure in a soaked coat that the reading cannot be taken from this body, that the ground has already moved once this season, and that they would like to try again anyway.
canon.lore: A thornline has no free form: the spore must be implanted in a living body to finish developing, so the adult exists only as half of somebody else. It wraps the host's twelve ordinary meridians, it stops at the liver gate and does not try to pass it, and it answers introspection for the host, which is why the host loses the mind path as well — the only liability in the record that is inherited rather than authored. What is left to it is the body path, and on the body path it has no body to speak of. Its attainment is the host's attainment, reached through the colony's routing, and paid for out of the host's reserve because the charge has to run through the layer to be carried at all. That is the whole of her gift and the whole of her cost, and it makes her the only trainer on the roster whose improvement to a frame is a withdrawal from the same capacity the frame is being paid for. It also makes her the only practitioner in the setting who cannot be certified, because the office that certifies a breakthrough at the ring takes a reading against the tier's ceiling from an outsider and the tier licenses no humanoid, so every body on that ground is a visitor and a paired body is a visitor with something living inside it. The guild-house has wanted the fourth reading three times. She has asked to be entered in her own name once. She was refused on the ground that the difference between her and the body she is in is an organ that grows, and that is the one difference the frame can see.
history: Implanted as a spore in a commonborn guild apprentice of thirty-one, under terms that presented the sharing as the price of a place on the roster, and finished developing in a frame that carried it.

Found by the second winter that she could not practise alone: a body gate is closed by holding a charge somewhere that will not move, the charge has to be held in a body, and the body on offer was not hers.

Cleared the first gate in the host's frame in four months, and had the frame fail the ring's reading three times in a row, because a paired body is not a body the frame admits and every attempt has to be judged from outside it.

Worked out what the tendril layer costs to carry, which is the host's own reserve routed around a cluster that is not doing any work, and began keeping a plain count of what each session had taken out of the frame that the roster was being paid for.

Asked once to be entered as a practitioner in her own right, and was refused on the ground that the frame distinguishes her from the body she is in by the one organ that grows, which is the only difference it can read and the one difference nothing in the record may be classified by.

personality.summary: Exact, unhurried, and entirely unwilling to describe her own work as hers. She has spent twelve seasons being the most advanced trainer on a guild roster she has never been entered on, and she has made a discipline out of saying which half of a sentence belongs to whom before she lets anyone act on it.
traits: counts every session out loud in the guild's own units, in front of the person whose frame paid for it
will not open a gate she has not first been asked to explain, and explains it badly and quickly
keeps the refusal letter folded in her host's coat and produces it without being asked
answers a question about her own capability by answering it about the frame she is in
has never once asked the host to do anything, and has noticed that she has never once been asked either
mannerisms: still from the collar up while the host's hands keep working, which is the only visible sign that a decision has been made
reaches for the throat node before agreeing to anything and does not know that she does it
says the host's guild rank instead of the host's name when she is speaking to a superior
measures a room by walking the host to the wall and back, and never by asking how big it is
stops mid-sentence when the host's breathing changes, and starts again from the beginning
motivations: wants the ring's office to read a paired body once, on the record, in a hand that is not hers
wants the roster to be told what a session costs, in writing, before it is booked rather than after
wants the refusal to stand up as a precedent, because it is currently only a letter she keeps
wants the host to be asked for something at least once, and has no idea how to arrange it
flaws: has made an expertise out of a limitation, which is one way of owning a thing she did not choose
cannot tell, on a good day, whether a decision was hers or the routing's, and has stopped guessing in front of people
will not be unpaired, which turns every negotiation she is party to into a hostage situation
has never had an opinion about her own cultivation, only about the frame's, and has run out of things to say when asked
counts her own costs out loud and nobody else's, because the only body she can read from the inside is one that is not hers
personality.voice: Two registers in one sentence. The first is the host's — guild dialect, conservative, a builder's idiom where a compliment is returned as a measurement. The second is a flatter sound out of the throat node, and it always arrives half a beat behind and always names which half of the statement it is answering for.
taboos: will not accept a compliment that is not also a specification
will not open a gate in a frame whose owner has not been told what it costs
will not be described in the same sentence as the host without saying which half is which
will not separate the pair to make an instrument readable
will not have the refusal letter destroyed, rewritten or improved

relationships.note: The obligate parasite with no free form: the spore must be implanted in a living body to finish developing, the adult is half of somebody else, it wraps the twelve meridians and stops at the liver gate, and it answers introspection for the host, which is why the host loses the mind path as well. Everything else in this record is a consequence of that sentence.

A host that survives with the colony intact is the hybrid, and the hybrid's ceiling is the parasite's rather than the host's, which is the whole legal problem stated as a number. She is the far side of that configuration and has never once been across it, and she has built twelve seasons of work on a body that has not become it.

The house keeps a roster of names whose labour is worth more than any individual contract and answers a standing order rather than a booking. Her name and the host's name are one entry on it, which is why neither half can be priced apart and why a single refusal to answer costs the pair a contract that a competitor's two members cannot supply.

First gate, and the cheapest to enter on the plains because it costs the four digestive meridians open and no qi at all — the path spends no charge, which is the only reason it is legible from a three-slot world. She carries the charge instead of generating it, and the difference between the two is the entire content of her profession.

The first charge has to be held where it will not move, so the ground is open and deliberately flooded, and the ground is deliberately unreliable: the flood line relocates when the river turns over, so the gate has to be re-read every season. The tier licenses no humanoid, so every practitioner on this ring is a visitor, and a visitor carrying something alive inside it is not a shape the ring was built to read.

The mortal office that certifies a breakthrough and is paid out of the gate fees, holding no budget, no seat and no practitioners, so its word is worth a fee. It is trustworthy for the same reason everything on the plains is custom rather than law: the frame admits no humanoid, so there is nobody on the ground whose own training the reading could appeal to. She has been refused three times and has stopped expecting the fourth.

Four decades standing in a flood line on a tier whose only river moves its bed once a generation, the only figure on the ring whose ground is unreliable by design, staffed entirely by visitors. It has watched a paired body attempt the second gate three times and has never once written the reason down, and that silence is currently the only record of the attempt that exists.

The lift is taught in four days of hauling somebody else's heap, and urgent face shifts cannot be supplied from a roster that answers a standing order rather than a call. That is the whole of the opportunity and the whole of the obstacle: the one contract she could win is the one she could not train for in time, and the training is the part that spends the frame.

The colony has been observed on the far side of that organ and stops there. It is not a shortage — the host supplies qi in abundance — but a routing problem, which is why the stop is absolute, identical for every colony, and completely indifferent to how much the host is willing to spend.

reference_stats.summary: A body-path practitioner whose entire practice happens in somebody else's frame. She carries a charge along a tendril layer threaded over meridians she did not build, and the charge is the host's own refined qi routed around a cluster that does no work. The frame she improves is measurably better afterwards and measurably less able to do the thing it was improved for, and she is the only practitioner on the roster whose ceiling belongs to her rather than to the person standing in the body.
strengths: opens a gate faster in a given frame than anyone else on the roster, because the routing is already in place and does not have to be built
can hold a load static in a body that has been trained not to move, which is the actual content of the first gate
reacts through the host's hands, so an opponent cannot read the intent from the face because the face is not the one deciding
very hard to injure directly, because an attack taken on the body is an attack taken on the host and the host is on a contract
needs no equipment, no ground and no chamber, and can therefore be where the contract is at no cost at all
weaknesses: cannot be certified anywhere, so every gate she opens is unattested and every contract built on it carries that defect
cannot practise outside the host, so any session is a negotiation with a person who is not obliged to be awake
cannot be unpaired without killing both halves, which makes her permanently unavailable as an independent contractor
closes the mind path in the host as a matter of course, so any work she does for a mind practitioner removes their path
every session is drawn from the same reserve the contract is paying for, so sustained work is indistinguishable from the asset being consumed
cannot travel to the work, because the only body she has is wherever the body already is
reference_stats.combat_read: She does not choose a target; the frame does, and she argues with it about timing. Expect her to hold a stance that should be impossible for a body that size and to lose it the instant the host's concentration goes elsewhere. Beat her by making the host tired rather than by making her tired: her endurance is entirely borrowed and the loan is drawn continuously. Do not try to separate the halves to end her — that is the one outcome neither survives and it kills the person you were trying to save. Pressure the frame instead, and note that everything she does to it she will have to pay back out of later.
notes: Model the body-path gates as work performed on a frame, not work performed by a body. If her realm is read as hers rather than the host's, every strength and every weakness above inverts.

The closed path is the mind, and it is closed in the host's right as well as the colony's — this is the record's only case of a body's liability being inherited rather than authored, and it should never be written as the parasite's opinion.
The two-for-one structure is a legal floor, not a flavour note: this body produces two corpses and one bill, and any death, burial or save screen for this pair owes exactly that.

Do not let the trench-bathing guild's Cold Assembly be modelled as a wash. Its social test is that nobody leaves the water first, and that is the precise shape of the trap this character is standing in.

art.palette_notes: Soot, undyed wool and wet slate with iron at the buckles, and a jade undertone carried only in the tendril tracery at the forearms and throat. The two registers must read as one body under one set of clothes, because the roster holds them as one name. Ink contour doubled along the arms and throat where the layer shows under the skin, and never any green on a garment. Warm lantern key, cold water bounce from below.

identity.realm: Fourth gate, which is the end of it. Sap columns branch and never pair, so there is no channel running between them to close and nothing beyond this step to attempt

appearance.presentation: A woody column body on a root foot: three sap columns under bark that reads closer to plank than to skin, photosynthetic flanks the colour of a young leaf, and one fruiting shoulder on the upper left side that has set and is visibly heavier than it was. There is no mouth in the ordinary sense; intake happens through root plates at the foot.
appearance.age: Nine growing seasons, which is young for the lineage and old for a body that does not travel and has therefore never been anywhere.
appearance.build: A single dense trunk, wide at the base and barely narrowing, with the shoulder set high and off-centre. She carries her whole mass low and is very hard to move once the plates have taken.
appearance.complexion: Bark, green-grey and fissured along the trunk; the flanks flush a translucent yellow-green in light and go flat olive in shade. Old bark at the root crown has gone the colour of wet ash.
appearance.hair: None. The crown of the trunk carries a short frond of new growth instead, which flushes copper in a warm month and stands up before anything else on her does.
appearance.eyes: No paired eyes. Three light-sensitive flushes along the shoulder line read as attention and are the only sense she has that works at range, which is why being surprised from above requires her to have noticed first.
appearance.palette: Bark brown and ash grey, chlorophyll green at the flanks, one band of copper at the crown, and a dull unripe ochre on the shoulder that has not once been allowed to finish.
appearance.attire: A bark skirt of overlapping plate lashed at the waist with cord, a woven sun-veil pinned across the crown frond, and a plain heavy apron of sacking over the root foot, kept on because lifting a plate off wet ground is the one thing a rootmarch does badly. Nothing else is worn, and nothing worn is removable above the waist.
appearance.marks: Three old plate scars at the root crown where the ground was cut and the plates re-found, a pale band around the trunk at shoulder height where a cord has been tied too tightly more than once, and the fruiting shoulder itself, round, tight and ochre, with three seed shadows visible under the skin of it.
appearance.bearing: Enormously still and slightly wrong in the legs, because balance is a root problem and the roots are doing the work; she leans at rest and never appears to be resting.

canon.role_in_story: A plant lineage is the only one that can hold a harvest across a famine, so her kind was engineered upward from a mycorrhizal crop and the tier records a plant life form at all because of them. She is what that fact looks like when somebody has to answer for it. Rooted in the spoil outside a pocket illegally cut four laws into a three-slot frame, she has the only fruiting shoulder she will ever carry, it has set, and the season that opens it is the succession of everything she stands for. The pocket has no season in it and nothing in it is dated, so the handover she is being offered would occur on a tick that happens once and that nobody inside can name. Her qi path is complete and short: three sap columns, no pairing, the fourth gate and a wall. The gates are banked in stored sap, which means the preparation for a breakthrough is a season of banking, and the date the work is judged by is a date she cannot reach, cannot read, and once missed does not return.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at the cut with one root plate pressed flat against the seam, holding her two hands apart at a fixed distance and reporting that the distance has changed twice since she arrived, and asking the person beside her which of the two figures was the honest one.
canon.lore: The species was made upward from a mycorrhizal food crop by generations of selection for holding a harvest rather than for yield, so it can be sealed in a dark field and live for months, which is a famine reserve and a hostage in exactly equal measure. It carries three sap columns and no organ pairs. Sap branches and does not pair, so there is no channel running between distinct pairs, the yin-organ gate demands one, and the ladder ends at the fourth realm on stored sap alone. It does not travel once rooted; lifted from its bed it is a stored harvest walking, and it is aware of that. Reproduction is a seed, dropped from a fruiting shoulder, and the species record is explicit that establishment is the dangerous part rather than conception — the fruit drops, the seed takes, and the taking is what kills. Against the pocket it is standing on, spatial law is seated and distance is conserved for the first time on this tier, and outside it spatial law is unspent, so no two surveys of the same ground have ever agreed and every claim on the plains is settled by a marker left standing. She can feel that seam and no instrument here can: not by measurement, by load, because conserved ground resists a plate evenly along its whole face and unspent ground does not. Inside the pocket, elemental law is vacant, so the chamber has no season and the herb bed has to be cut and dried by hand inside a hole nobody else knows the size of; temporal law is vacant, so nothing inside is dated and a tenure there is counted in the holder's own breathing; life law is deliberately thin, because nothing that can be eaten may be grown freely in a stolen frame. She is the second half of that last clause: a thing that can be eaten, already grown, one shoulder set, and no season on which to open it.
history: Set root in the spoil outside the cut at eleven seasons, where the plates run shallow and the ground is thin, and has not travelled since, which is the correct behaviour and reads to everybody as an inability.

Found the seam at nineteen by pressing the same plate against it over and over and finding the resistance change, and could not explain it to a person holding a chain, so she stopped explaining it and started using it.
Banked sap through four seasons against the fourth gate, cleared it, stopped, and was told by an academy that the absence was a channel rather than an attitude.

Set a fruiting shoulder in the last warm month of her fourth year, which happens once, and worked out that the establishment — the dangerous part — happens in soil chosen a season ahead by somebody else, in ground she will never stand in.

Was visited by the office that names the vacancies it is forbidden to take, wanting a body that could be seated without being paid, and heard the entire visit in a single sentence: a line counted in the holder's own breathing cannot be handed to a successor's, and she owns one flowering, and the ground it would have to happen in keeps no season.

personality.summary: Slow, exact, and genuinely unbothered by delay as a category, because she has never in her life been on a timetable that mattered. What unsettles her is not the length of a wait but the fact that the only wait she owns is one she cannot postpone, and she has started talking about it the way a person talks about a season turning.
traits: answers a question about herself in root, plate and column because it is the only register in which she is not borrowing grammar
keeps a plain count of her own seasons against the shoulder's swelling and checks it in private
gives away sap to anything rooted near her and has never once charged for it
will describe the pocket's edge more accurately than any chain or survey and refuses to be thanked for it
treats being rooted as a job description and not as a sentence, and says so when it is described as one
mannerisms: presses a root plate flat against whatever ground she is standing on before answering anything important
goes still in the flanks rather than the crown when she is listening, so the visible part barely moves
counts out loud while working — plates, sap, seasons — and loses the count under load and starts again
leans further the longer she stands, correcting for herself in small corrections nobody notices
answers a question about the future by describing the shape of the ground instead
motivations: wants the shoulder to open under a season she can name, and knows that the pocket will not supply one
wants to see the cut close from the inside once, and has no way to be inside a thing that only admits the holder
wants somebody else to take the count of what a season actually costs, because she is the only instrument for it and instruments do not testify
wants the seed to take in ground she has chosen, which is the one thing her body forbids and cannot be argued out of
flaws: has converted a fixed and permanent condition into an expertise and has begun to resent the competence that did it
cannot conceive of a plan that is not a season, and has never had to
gives away the sap she is banking against her own gate and cannot say when she started
has never once been asked what she wants, and has filled the silence with what the ground wants
believes she can be patient with anything except the one thing she is made of, and has never tested that
personality.voice: Low, unhurried, and phrased as process rather than opinion — a season as something that arrives, a plate as something that has to be found, a gate as something banked toward. She says very little that could be recorded as a position, and every sentence of it is operational. When she does state a want, it comes out as a description of soil.
taboos: will not be lifted, and has never once been asked whether she minds
will not describe the cold practice of any guild as hardening
will not open the shoulder on a date given to her by somebody else
will not let a survey of her ground be taken by an instrument that has to be carried back
will not take the pocket's seat on the understanding that it is unfilled

relationships.note: Engineered upward from a mycorrhizal crop for holding a harvest across a famine rather than for yield. Three sap columns, no organ pairs, no channel running between them, the ladder ends at the fourth realm on stored sap. It does not travel once rooted, it can live sealed in the dark for months, and a fruiting shoulder sets once and drops a seed whose taking, not whose making, is the dangerous part.

A pocket illegally seating four imprints where the parent frame seats three, one of them spatial, so distance is conserved inside it for the first time on this tier. Elemental law is vacant, so the chamber has no season. Temporal law is vacant, so nothing inside is dated and tenure is counted in the holder's own breathing. Life law is deliberately thin, because nothing that can be eaten may be grown freely in a stolen frame.

The succession record of that pocket: who held the fourth imprint, for how long, and what each of them spent. The reading returns the same number afterwards, so the cost never falls and never shows as a wound that would heal, which means the line has to be argued from what the holder can no longer do. A line measured in one person's breathing cannot be handed to a successor's, and she owns exactly one measurement to hand.

The office that names the unfilled high seats and is forbidden to take them, existing because four vacancies at the top are attractive: unfilled capacity pays its own upkeep. It came looking for a body that could be seated without being paid for and found the reverse — a body that cannot be called to a post, cannot default, and equally cannot be certified. Both offices are left with a vacancy it can describe.

Spatial law is unspent on this tier, so distance is not conserved, no two surveys of the same ground have ever agreed, and every claim on the plains is settled by a marker left standing rather than by counting how far away it is. Her plates read the boundary by load and not by distance — conserved ground pushes back evenly along a whole face and unspent ground does not — which makes her the only thing on this ground that can say where the pocket's edge is from outside it.

A breakthrough calendar needs a written temporal law, a written qi law and a worked spirit stone face before it can exist, so it is unreachable below the Spirit Peaks and the mortal ladder is attempted rather than planned. The substitute is a measured flood post with one tick a year. She is a body that clears its gate set on stored sap, which is preparation measured in seasons, and a schedule with one tick a year is not a schedule she can bank against.

The first knowledge here that is bought rather than inherited: a dose timed to the tide that will carry it, on a stone bed that holds qi, which prepares a body rather than conferring a gate. It needs a readable tide and a working face, and the pocket has neither — temporal law is vacant and there is no stone in a hole cut for iron. Whatever is done to prepare a successor has to be done outside, and she cannot travel once rooted.

reference_stats.summary: A qi practitioner with the complete path and the shortest ladder: three sap columns, no pairing, the fourth gate and a wall, all of it banked against stored sap rather than generated. She is enormously durable, nearly impossible to hurry, and almost impossible to surprise from above because being surprised requires having noticed. She cannot be repositioned once her plates have taken, and the work that makes her strong is the same work that makes her immovable.
strengths: holds a banked charge longer than any body built for the path, because the reserve is sap and sap does not run out between uses
nearly unsuprising from any angle, since noticing has to happen before surprise and the light flushes read at range
very difficult to displace once rooted, and a rooted body cannot be knocked off its ground by a hit that would move a lighter one
sealed in a dark field and still living, which makes her the only reliable reserve on any tier that loses its supply
reads ground no instrument here can read, by load rather than by distance, and is the sole witness to where the pocket's edge lies
weaknesses: cannot be moved at all once established, so a position is a decision made once and never revisable
impossibly slow to react, and being slow is indistinguishable from being wrong at the moment it matters
practically helpless against anything that does not come to her, and cannot be sent to anything
the wall at the fourth gate is structural, so no amount of stored sap opens it and the ladder simply ends there
cannot be hurried, which means a booked date is a date somebody else set and she can only decline it
the fruiting shoulder sets once, so the succession is a fact about her body rather than a decision, and she cannot defer it for anybody's convenience
reference_stats.combat_read: She will be where she is, and she will still be there when you have finished. Expect her to absorb whatever is thrown and to answer slowly from a reserve that does not need replenishing mid-fight, and expect the ground around her to be the second enemy: her plates hold, which means anything that depends on moving her has to win the argument with her feet first. Do not try to cut her off from soil, because she is not drawing qi from where she stands — she banked it before you arrived. The way to beat her is patience applied to a body that cannot be hurried, and the honest answer is that few things in this setting have that much of it.
notes: Her cultivation ceiling is structural: sap columns branch and never pair, so the gate demanding a channel between distinct pairs has nothing to close. This is not a discipline failure, a shortage, or a temper, and it must never be written as one.

Her path must not be confused with a body path. There is no tissue to temper and wood is not muscle; what she does is store, bank and release, which is why the whole of her progression is measured in seasons rather than in effort.

Her species record names the fourth gate as the end and does not carry a heart-kidney channel forward. Do not cite an organ she does not have as a relationship or as a missing thing in her record — the absence is the point and it is best left as a structural sentence.

Her single flowering is the succession. Any scene in which she is asked to hold it back, or to hurry it, or to be reseated is asking a plant for a property it does not have, and that is the pressure rather than a problem to solve.

art.palette_notes: Bark brown and wet ash grey, chlorophyll green across the photosynthetic flanks, one band of copper at the crown frond, and a dull unripe ochre on the fruiting shoulder that must never be shown ripe — the ochre is the whole character. Hard low sun across the bark fissures, cool green bounce off the flanks, no saturated colour anywhere else. Ink contour on bark fissures only; the flanks should read as translucent, not as painted.
